## Kind of change

- [ ] **Specification PR** (label `spec`): requirements, contracts, work-in-progress tests, change folder. Reviewed by
      a spec owner other than the author.
- [ ] **Implementation PR**: one task from `docs/specs/changes/<change>/tasks.md`. Touches no protected path except
      deleting `@wip` lines.
